title: Harbor Learning Lab — Practice Handbook
label: ORIGINAL SYNTHETIC TEACHING REPLACEMENT — not the source video PDF

pages.heading: Open day and access
paragraphs: Harbor Learning Lab is a fictional community learning project. These policies exist only for Python RAG practice. No organisation, booking, person, price or event described here is real.

The Harbor Learning Lab open day is 14 March 2027. The welcome session begins at 10:00 and ends at 12:00. There are 24 seats. Visitors reserve a seat by emailing welcome@harbor.example with the subject Open day reservation. The event is free. Reservations close on 10 March 2027.

The venue is the fictional North Room. Step-free access is available through the east entrance. Visitors may request a large-print guide when reserving. The handbook does not specify catering, parking, transport or a weather-cancellation policy. Staff must not invent policies for omitted topics.

pages.heading: Equipment loans and returns
paragraphs: Harbor Learning Lab lends practice equipment to registered learners. The standard equipment loan lasts 7 calendar days. A learner may request one renewal of 3 additional calendar days if no other learner has reserved the equipment. A renewal must be requested before the original due date.

An equipment loan request must include the learner's name, item name and preferred collection date. Send the request to equipment@harbor.example. A facilitator confirms availability before collection; sending a request does not guarantee a booking. No deposits or late-fee amounts are specified in this handbook.

If an item is damaged or missing, stop using it and contact equipment@harbor.example promptly. Do not attempt a repair. Returns go to the fictional North Room equipment desk. The handbook does not specify replacement costs or purchase prices.

pages.heading: Practice records and escalation
paragraphs: Use synthetic names and invented example messages in all coding practice. Never put credentials, medical details or real learner contact information in a prompt or trace. Harbor Learning Lab practice reservation records are retained for 30 days and then deleted. This is a fictional classroom policy, not legal advice.

An unanswered policy question must be escalated to coordinator@harbor.example. State which fact is missing and do not guess. A draft message is not a sent message: learners must review the recipient, facts and wording before using a draft. Nothing in this handbook authorises an application to send email automatically.

This document contains no stock-market returns, company earnings, opening hours beyond the open-day welcome session, catering menu, late-fee schedule or production security standard. Similar-looking retrieved text does not supply those missing facts. Cite the actual page supporting a claim, not merely the first search result.
